items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: He has performed with Clark Terry, Zoot Sims and Maynard Ferguson

ctx.x: Michael Abene was born in New York City on July 2, 1942. He has performed with Clark Terry, Zoot Sims and Maynard Ferguson and has written arrangements for a lengthy list of jazz singers and ensembles. Michael is in constant demand as composer and clinician and currently teaches at the Manhattan School of Music.
Michael was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 11, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
